contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ NERO CAESAR [AVG] IMP ; R/ PONTIE

A Roman silver-plated coin with copper alloy core, a contemporary copy of a denarius of Nero dating AD63-64. Reverse: Virtus standing left, PONTIE (error should be PONTIF) MAX TR P X COS IIII PP. Mint: Rome. RIC no. 47/8. Reece period 3. Obverse: Bare-headed bust right. Obverse inscription: NERO CAESAR [AVG] IMP. Reverse: Virtus, helmeted, in military dress, standing left, right foot on helmet…
